_arch_note: [FFN-LUT sweep S2a] SWEEP2 same-envelope: 0084 with nap 7->9 (cells 128->512). Pure free-capacity: 4x cells at ~zero extra FLOP/vBW. Base = exp_n_0084 (untied head, FFN CompressionMHL slot). SHORT-RUN schedule n_steps=3500 (same LR schedule across the whole sweep so runs are comparable). Standard LUT optimizer (AdamW, tables in nodecay wd=0), init noise 0.001. Everything else identical to exp_n_0084.
_mem_note: nap9 (cells=512) doubles the FastMHL soft-backward [B, H*tph, cells] intermediate vs the nap8 configs (which peak ~50-55GB at bs24), OOMing at bs24. device_batch_size 24->12 (grad_accum auto 2->4) halves the B-scaled buffers; effective batch stays 24,576 (grad accumulation is exact) so the science and the shared 3500-step schedule are unchanged.
